title: 高水壓隧道止水灌漿~Water-control grouting in high-pressure tunnels
focus: 用水頭、壓力損失與滲流證據評估高水壓止水灌漿~Assess high-head water-control grouting using head, pressure loss and seepage evidence
summary: 本課以用水頭、壓力損失與滲流證據評估高水壓止水灌漿為主線，從水頭基準與孔隙水壓與泵表讀值與孔段壓力建立系統邊界，再把幾何體積與實際注入量、前後透水比較與水頭連到驗收範圍與長期水路。算例只描述水力關係，不提供現地配方、注入壓力或施作授權。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。~This course focuses on assess high-head water-control grouting using head, pressure loss and seepage evidence. It begins with Head datum and pore pressure and Pump gauge and interval pressure, links Geometric volume and delivered volume and Before-after permeability and head, and ends with Acceptance coverage and long-term pathways. Examples describe hydraulic relationships, not field recipes, injection pressures or operating authorization. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.

units.anchor: 水頭基準與孔隙水壓~Head datum and pore pressure
units.title: 水頭基準與孔隙水壓~Head datum and pore pressure
units.mechanism: 高水壓首先是水位與量測點高程的關係，埋深不一定等於水頭。承壓含水層可在地表以上形成測壓水位，不同孔段也可能不連通；應把量測位置和基準高程清楚標出，再比較外部水壓與隧道內部條件。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將分段測壓水位、孔口高程及量測深度換到共同基準；若出現混用地表深度與水頭使設計水壓估錯，錯判止水需求，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~High pressure depends on piezometric level relative to the measurement point, not burial depth alone. Confined levels may exceed ground surface and different intervals may be disconnected. Identify measurement elevations and datums before comparing external water pressure with tunnel conditions. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Reduce interval heads, collar elevations and measurement depths to a common datum. If confusing depth with head misestimates water pressure and water-control demand, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

Examples describe hydraulic relationships, not field recipes, injection pressures or operating authorization. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Confusing depth with head misestimates water pressure and water-control demand. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.
units.failure: 混用地表深度與水頭使設計水壓估錯，錯判止水需求。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將分段測壓水位、孔口高程及量測深度換到共同基準，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。~Confusing depth with head misestimates water pressure and water-control demand. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to reduce interval heads, collar elevations and measurement depths to a common datum to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.
units.misconception: 隧道埋得多深就一定有完全相同的地下水頭~Tunnel burial depth always equals the groundwater head
units.practice: 將將分段測壓水位、孔口高程及量測深度換到共同基準列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現混用地表深度與水頭使設計水壓估錯，錯判止水需求，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。~Apply the following check at handover: Reduce interval heads, collar elevations and measurement depths to a common datum. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If confusing depth with head misestimates water pressure and water-control demand, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

units.anchor: 泵表讀值與孔段壓力~Pump gauge and interval pressure
units.title: 泵表讀值與孔段壓力~Pump gauge and interval pressure
units.mechanism: 泵表位置和目標孔段高程不同，管線摩擦及局部損失也使讀值不能直接當孔內壓力。壓差隨流量、材料和管路狀態改變，靜止時與流動時的校核意義不同；必須定義正負高程和壓力類型，避免重複扣除水頭。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以可用孔段壓力、流量及管路校核共同檢查泵表換算；若出現只讀泵表而忽略堵管損失，誤以為目標地層已受相同壓力，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Gauge elevation differs from the target interval, while line and local losses prevent direct transfer of readings. Loss changes with flow, material and pipe condition, so static and flowing checks differ. Define elevation signs and pressure type to avoid counting head corrections twice. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check gauge conversion using available interval pressure, flow and line calibration. If ignoring line blockage losses falsely assigns gauge pressure to the target ground, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

Examples describe hydraulic relationships, not field recipes, injection pressures or operating authorization. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

units.anchor: 孔隙壓與有效作用差~Pore pressure and net pressure difference
units.title: 孔隙壓與有效作用差~Pore pressure and net pressure difference
units.mechanism: 注入端壓力與原地下水壓之差影響流動，但不能單獨決定地層是否會開裂或抬升。最小主應力、既有裂隙與連通路徑同樣重要，局部壓力還可能傳到遠處薄弱面；模型應區分水力驅動差與允許作用上限。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照孔段壓差、周邊位移及相鄰測壓反應；若出現把淨壓差小誤當無風險，忽略遠處低拘束裂隙開啟，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~The difference between injection and groundwater pressure drives flow but does not alone establish fracture or uplift risk. Minimum stress, existing joints and connectivity also matter, with pressure reaching remote weak planes. Distinguish a hydraulic driving difference from an allowable action limit. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare interval pressure difference with surrounding movement and neighbouring head responses. If a small net difference is treated as risk-free despite remote low-restraint joints opening, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：netDifference=0.8481 MPa-0.7848 MPa=0.0633 MPa=63.3 kPa。算例只描述水力關係，不提供現地配方、注入壓力或施作授權。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: netDifference=0.8481 MPa-0.7848 MPa=0.0633 MPa=63.3 kPa. Examples describe hydraulic relationships, not field recipes, injection pressures or operating authorization. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

units.anchor: 裂隙開度與流量敏感度~Fracture aperture and flow sensitivity
units.title: 裂隙開度與流量敏感度~Fracture aperture and flow sensitivity
units.mechanism: 理想平行板層流的流量對開度立方敏感，微小開合可大幅改變流量。天然裂隙粗糙、分岔且有接觸點，不能從一個流量唯一反算開度；此模型適合解釋為何少數連通裂隙可能主導整體漏水。 判別這個機制時，應觀察在可比水頭下比較分段流量與裂隙連通證據；若出現只封小裂隙卻漏掉主通道，總流量改善有限，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Ideal parallel-plate laminar flow varies with aperture cubed, so small changes can strongly alter discharge. Natural joints are rough, branching and partly contacting, preventing unique aperture inference from one flow. The model explains why a few connected fractures can dominate leakage. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare interval flow and fracture connectivity at comparable heads. If sealing minor cracks while missing the main pathway gives little total-flow improvement, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：flowRatio=(newAperture/oldAperture)^3=(1.1)^3=1.331。算例只描述水力關係，不提供現地配方、注入壓力或施作授權。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: flowRatio=(newAperture/oldAperture)^3=(1.1)^3=1.331. Examples describe hydraulic relationships, not field recipes, injection pressures or operating authorization. units.anchor: 幾何體積與實際注入量~Geometric volume and delivered volume
units.title: 幾何體積與實際注入量~Geometric volume and delivered volume
units.mechanism: 理想處理環體積可作材料帳基準，但地層不是均勻多孔體，注入可能集中在少數通道。超過理論體積並不證明處理半徑增加，可能是外逸或相鄰孔連通；必須把材料去向和地下水反應一起辨認。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將注入收支、相鄰孔反應及可見逸流位置共同索引；若出現大量外逸被當成有效填充，留下未處理的高滲區，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~An ideal treatment annulus offers a volume baseline, but ground is not a uniform porous medium and delivery may concentrate in a few channels. Excess volume does not prove a larger treatment radius; it may escape or connect to another hole. Interpret material destinations with groundwater response. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Index delivered balance, neighbouring-hole responses and visible escape locations together. If large losses are credited as useful filling while high-permeability zones remain untreated, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

units.anchor: 材料可灌性與粒徑~Grout penetrability and particle size
units.title: 材料可灌性與粒徑~Grout penetrability and particle size
units.mechanism: 材料能否進入裂隙取決於粒徑分布、開度、流變和過濾作用，平均粒徑不能代表最大團聚體。入口堵塞可能讓孔口壓力升高但深部仍未處理，因而壓力與流量變化不能直接解讀為地層已封閉；材料選擇需要相容試驗證據。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較材料粒徑、濾失試驗與壓力流量曲線的形狀；若出現孔口濾餅造成假性拒漿，深部水路仍持續連通，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Penetrability depends on size distribution, aperture, rheology and filtration, not mean particle size alone. Entrance clogging can raise collar pressure while leaving deeper ground untreated. Pressure-flow changes therefore do not directly establish closure and material selection needs compatibility evidence. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare particle distribution, filtration tests and pressure-flow curve shapes. If an entrance filter cake produces apparent refusal while deeper pathways remain connected, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：geometricRatio=aperture/d95=0.20 mm/0.04 mm=5, not a universal penetrability criterion。算例只描述水力關係，不提供現地配方、注入壓力或施作授權。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: geometricRatio=aperture/d95=0.20 mm/0.04 mm=5, not a universal penetrability criterion. Examples describe hydraulic relationships, not field recipes, injection pressures or operating authorization. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.
units.verify: 比較材料粒徑、濾失試驗與壓力流量曲線的形狀。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「孔口濾餅造成假性拒漿，深部水路仍持續連通」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。~Compare particle distribution, filtration tests and pressure-flow curve shapes. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: An entrance filter cake produces apparent refusal while deeper pathways remain connected. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.
units.failure: 孔口濾餅造成假性拒漿，深部水路仍持續連通。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較材料粒徑、濾失試驗與壓力流量曲線的形狀，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。~An entrance filter cake produces apparent refusal while deeper pathways remain connected. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare particle distribution, filtration tests and pressure-flow curve shapes to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.
units.misconception: 入口壓力升高就能證明整個處理區都已封閉~Rising entrance pressure proves the entire treated zone is sealed
units.practice: 將比較材料粒徑、濾失試驗與壓力流量曲線的形狀列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現孔口濾餅造成假性拒漿，深部水路仍持續連通，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。~Apply the following check at handover: Compare particle distribution, filtration tests and pressure-flow curve shapes. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If an entrance filter cake produces apparent refusal while deeper pathways remain connected, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

units.anchor: 前後透水比較與水頭~Before-after permeability and head
units.title: 前後透水比較與水頭~Before-after permeability and head
units.mechanism: 處理前後流量若在不同水頭下量測，直接百分比可能混入地下水自然變化。線性水力導通度只適用特定範圍，裂隙開合會造成非線性；比較應使用相同孔段、時間尺度及可比邊界，並保留未達穩態的資料註記。 判別這個機制時，應觀察在相同孔段和可比水頭下比較穩態流量及恢復曲線；若出現天然水位下降被錯算成灌漿成效，雨季水頭恢復後再漏，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Before-after flows measured at different heads mix treatment with natural groundwater change. Linear conductance applies only over a specified range because joint opening can be nonlinear. Compare the same intervals and time scales under similar boundaries and identify readings that have not reached steady conditions. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare steady flow and recovery curves in matching intervals at comparable heads. If natural head decline is credited to treatment and leakage returns when seasonal head recovers, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：reduction=(Qbefore-Qafter)/Qbefore=(10-2) L/min/10 L/min=80 percent at equal head。算例只描述水力關係，不提供現地配方、注入壓力或施作授權。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: reduction=(Qbefore-Qafter)/Qbefore=(10-2) L/min/10 L/min=80 percent at equal head. Examples describe hydraulic relationships, not field recipes, injection pressures or operating authorization. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Natural head decline is credited to treatment and leakage returns when seasonal head recovers. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.
units.failure: 天然水位下降被錯算成灌漿成效，雨季水頭恢復後再漏。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到在相同孔段和可比水頭下比較穩態流量及恢復曲線，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。~Natural head decline is credited to treatment and leakage returns when seasonal head recovers. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare steady flow and recovery curves in matching intervals at comparable heads to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.
units.misconception: 處理後流量降低就一定全部來自灌漿改善~Every post-treatment flow decrease is entirely caused by grouting improvement
units.practice: 將在相同孔段和可比水頭下比較穩態流量及恢復曲線列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現天然水位下降被錯算成灌漿成效，雨季水頭恢復後再漏，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。~Apply the following check at handover: Compare steady flow and recovery curves in matching intervals at comparable heads. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If natural head decline is credited to treatment and leakage returns when seasonal head recovers, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

units.anchor: 地層抬升與遠端反應~Ground uplift and remote response
units.title: 地層抬升與遠端反應~Ground uplift and remote response
units.mechanism: 壓力傳遞可能超出預期處理半徑，薄弱界面或地表覆土較少處會先變形。孔口附近沒有移動不能排除遠端反應，鄰近結構與水位也可能提供訊息；監測範圍應由地質連通模型決定，而不是固定圍住設備。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將地表水準、結構位移和相鄰孔壓放在共同時間軸；若出現遠端抬升先發生卻未佈點，局部監測誤判沒有影響，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Pressure transmission can extend beyond the assumed treatment radius and deform weak or shallow interfaces first. No collar movement does not exclude remote response; nearby structures and heads supply additional evidence. Base monitoring coverage on geological connectivity rather than a fixed circle around equipment. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Align surface levels, structural movement and neighbouring pore pressures. If uninstrumented remote uplift begins while local monitoring falsely suggests no effect, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：upliftGradient=levelDifference/distance=2 mm/10 m=0.0002。算例只描述水力關係，不提供現地配方、注入壓力或施作授權。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: upliftGradient=levelDifference/distance=2 mm/10 m=0.0002. units.anchor: 水化學與耐久相容~Water chemistry and durability compatibility
units.title: 水化學與耐久相容~Water chemistry and durability compatibility
units.mechanism: 止水材料長期接觸地下水，化學侵蝕、溶出或體積變化可能改變密封效果。短期不漏不等於材料與環境相容，溫度和流速也影響暴露；試驗應比較服務環境下的留存性能，而非只採容易得到的室內浸泡結果。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將水質、溫度及老化後滲透與強度資料共同審查；若出現材料溶出留下新通道，短期合格卻長期重新滲漏，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Water-control materials remain exposed to groundwater, where attack, leaching and volume change can alter sealing. Initial tightness does not establish compatibility, and temperature and flow affect exposure. Compare retained performance under representative service conditions rather than convenient immersion results alone. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Review water chemistry, temperature and post-ageing permeability and strength together. If material leaching creates new pathways despite initially passing leakage checks, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：retainedStrength=aged/reference=8 MPa/10 MPa=80 percent。算例只描述水力關係，不提供現地配方、注入壓力或施作授權。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: retainedStrength=aged/reference=8 MPa/10 MPa=80 percent. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

units.anchor: 驗收範圍與長期水路~Acceptance coverage and long-term pathways
units.title: 驗收範圍與長期水路~Acceptance coverage and long-term pathways
units.mechanism: 止水效果需針對設計範圍與地下水邊界驗證，單孔低透水不能代表全部帷幕連續。水可能繞過未處理端部或沿新裂隙改道，交接應保存孔段、材料、量測水頭與未驗證區；維護才能分辨原缺口和後續變化。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將獨立驗證孔段與處理範圍及未驗證區逐一對照；若出現帷幕端部未封閉讓水繞流，中心孔合格仍無法控制湧水，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Verify the design volume and groundwater boundary rather than treating low permeability in one hole as continuous coverage. Water can bypass ends or take new fractures. Preserve intervals, materials, test heads and unverified zones so maintenance distinguishes original gaps from later changes. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare independent verification intervals with treatment extent and unverified zones. If an open treatment edge permits bypass despite passing central holes, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：verificationCoverage=verifiedIntervals/requiredIntervals=36/40=90 percent。算例只描述水力關係，不提供現地配方、注入壓力或施作授權。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: verificationCoverage=verifiedIntervals/requiredIntervals=36/40=90 percent. Examples describe hydraulic relationships, not field recipes, injection pressures or operating authorization. example: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查水頭基準與孔隙水壓：Inputs rho=1000 kg/m3, g=9.81 m/s2, h=80 m; p=rho*g*h=1000*9.81*80=784800 Pa=0.7848 MPa；再獨立檢查泵表讀值與孔段壓力：Inputs conveyed-fluid density=1000 kg/m3, g=9.81 m/s2, downward elevation change=10 m; pInterval=0.90 MPa+0.0981 MPa-0.15 MPa=0.8481 MPa; another grout density requires recalculating the hydrostatic term。水頭由 80 增為 100 m，淡水靜壓由 0.7848 增為 0.981 MPa；泵壓仍須修正高程及沿程損失，不能把差值當成允許提高注壓的指令。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為算例只描述水力關係，不提供現地配方、注入壓力或施作授權。 將將地表水準、結構位移和相鄰孔壓放在共同時間軸作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。~All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Head datum and pore pressure: Inputs rho=1000 kg/m3, g=9.81 m/s2, h=80 m; p=rho*g*h=1000*9.81*80=784800 Pa=0.7848 MPa. Independently check Pump gauge and interval pressure: Inputs conveyed-fluid density=1000 kg/m3, g=9.81 m/s2, downward elevation change=10 m; pInterval=0.90 MPa+0.0981 MPa-0.15 MPa=0.8481 MPa; another grout density requires recalculating the hydrostatic term. Increasing freshwater head from 80 to 100 m raises static pressure from 0.7848 to 0.981 MPa; pump readings still require elevation and loss corrections, not an instruction to increase field pressure. The two results are not a complete design because examples describe hydraulic relationships, not field recipes, injection pressures or operating authorization. Use align surface levels, structural movement and neighbouring pore pressures as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
history: 本課討論的用水頭、壓力損失與滲流證據評估高水壓止水灌漿，反映地下工程由單一構件強度走向地層、施工時序與維護共同驗證的發展。算例只描述水力關係，不提供現地配方、注入壓力或施作授權。 1992 年 CEDD 岩洞指南初版、2009 年 FHWA 隧道土木手冊及 2018 年岩洞指南第二版提供公開閱讀脈絡。哥達與英法海底隧道僅作地質及地下水邊界的比較，本課不主張取得其專有圖說或現場數據，只重建公開原理。~The focus on assess high-head water-control grouting using head, pressure loss and seepage evidence reflects the development from isolated member strength toward combined ground, sequence and maintenance verification. Examples describe hydraulic relationships, not field recipes, injection pressures or operating authorization. The 1992 first CEDD cavern guide, 2009 FHWA civil tunnel manual and 2018 second cavern-guide edition provide public context. Gotthard and the Channel Tunnel are comparisons of geological and groundwater boundaries only. This course claims no proprietary drawings or field data and reconstructs public principles.
